observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== app process env (profile + mock auth) ==="; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/22747/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE|VITE_SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE|SVA_MOCK_AUTH|VITE_MOCK_AUTH|SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL|SVA_MAINSERVER_REQUIRED|ENABLE_OTEL' | sort
echo; echo "=== child (run-executor) env fallback ==="; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/22888/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=|SVA_MOCK_AUTH=|VITE_SVA_DEV_AUTH|SVA_DEV_AUTH' | sort
echo; echo "=== TLS certs ==="; ls -la dev/redis-tls/ 2>/dev/null
echo; echo "=== compose infra health (fresh) ==="; docker exec sva-studio-postgres pg_isready 2>&1; docker exec workspace-redis-1 redis-cli -a "$(grep '^REDIS_PASSWORD=' config/runtime/base.vars | cut -d= -f2)" ping 2>/dev/null
